description: Edit a card. Only the fields you send change: title, description, priority, type, dueDate, startDate, estimateSeconds, storyPoints, ready, columnId (move within the SAME board — a cross-board move is zuuna_move_card_to_board), assigneeIds (REPLACES the full set; [] clears everyone), customFields (object keyed by field id; null/empty clears one — zuuna_list_board_fields names the ids and the option vocabulary).

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.

dueDate.description: "YYYY-MM-DD" (anchored at noon UTC) or a full ISO 8601 timestamp. null clears it.
